name: Customer service / tech support representative (Concentrix Canada)
summary: Concentrix hires customer service and tech support reps in Canada, but recent Canadian postings seen are hybrid or on-site; remote Canadian postings found are old.
whatYouDo: You handle customer calls for a client brand, troubleshooting products or accounts on shifts that can run from early morning to late night, seven days a week. Some sites rotate schedules every few months based on performance.
appeal: Large established employer with paid classroom training
Posted Canadian base pay $19.70–$25/hr on recent hybrid/on-site roles
watchOuts: Canada work-from-home filter showed 0 jobs when indexed; remote Canadian postings found (~$21.49/hr night shift Calgary) are ~2.5 years old
Hybrid roles require living within ~35 km of a site (e.g. Niagara Falls)
Rotating shifts 8am–11:30pm, 7 days, changing every 3 months
Scammers impersonate Concentrix recruiters with look-alike emails; Concentrix publishes a scam warning
WFH roles test internet speed and system requirements

credentials: high school diploma or GED (on postings seen)

training.notes: Belleville bilingual posting lists 12 days of paid classroom training.

compensation.notes: Posted base pay: $19.70 hybrid Niagara Falls; $25 on-site bilingual Belleville; $21.49 remote night shift Calgary and $16–$18 remote inside sales Vancouver (both ~910 days old).

reliability.notes: Remote Canadian availability unclear; recent Canadian postings are site-based.

applicationSteps: Search jobs.concentrix.com filtered to Canada and check whether a role is remote, hybrid or on-site
Apply only on jobs.concentrix.com; real recruiters use @concentrix.com addresses
Pass internet speed/system checks for any WFH role
fitsIf: You live near a Canadian Concentrix site and want a structured call-centre job with paid training.
notFitIf: You need fully remote work now or fixed daytime hours.
